[NDBG.14r.6.5] **Binding check.** When the adapter pairs a trace with
the session's program, it must apply [RFCS.4.5]'s check of the trace against
that program. A mismatch is fatal to the load and surfaces as a DAP `error`
response. Its `body.error` is a DAP `Message` whose `variables` hold the
underlying `DS_ERR_BND_*` code's name under `code`, so a client reads it at
`body.error.variables.code`; the message's text is for a person and binds no
client. The adapter may
make the comparison in its own code, as [RBND.6.3] admits a reader outside a
runtime.
